title: Phrasal verbs (Transitive and intransitive, separable and inseparable) - Introduction

options.answer: She looked up it in the dictionary.
She looked it up in the dictionary.
She looked up in the dictionary it.

explanation.en: With separable phrasal verbs and pronoun objects, the pronoun must go between the verb and particle.
explanation.ru: С разделяемыми фразовыми глаголами и местоимениями-дополнениями местоимение должно стоять между глаголом и частицей.
explanation.uz: Ajraladigan frazeologik fe'llar va olmosh to'ldiruvchilarda olmosh fe'l va zarra o'rtasida turishi kerak.

options.answer: The plane took off on time.
The plane took on time off.
The plane off took on time.

explanation.en: Intransitive phrasal verbs cannot be separated and take no object.
explanation.ru: Непереходные фразовые глаголы нельзя разделять, и они не принимают дополнение.
explanation.uz: O'tuvchi bo'lmagan frazeologik fe'llarni ajratib bo'lmaydi va ular to'ldiruvchi olmaydi.

options.answer: I ran into my teacher at the store.
I ran my teacher into at the store.
I ran into at the store my teacher.

explanation.en: Inseparable phrasal verbs cannot be divided and the object comes after the particle.
explanation.ru: Неразделяемые фразовые глаголы нельзя разделить, и дополнение идет после частицы.
explanation.uz: Ajralmaydigan frazeologik fe'llarni bo'lib bo'lmaydi va to'ldiruvchi zarra keyin keladi.

options.answer: Please turn the music down.
Please turn down the music.
Please turn the music down.

explanation.en: Both positions are correct with separable phrasal verbs when using noun objects.
explanation.ru: Обе позиции правильны с разделяемыми фразовыми глаголами при использовании существительных как дополнений.
explanation.uz: Ot to'ldiruvchilarda ajraladigan frazeologik fe'llar bilan ikkala pozitsiya ham to'g'ri.

options.answer: She gets with her colleagues along well.
She gets along with her colleagues well.
She gets along well with her colleagues.

explanation.en: Inseparable phrasal verbs must keep the verb and particle together, followed by the object.
explanation.ru: Неразделяемые фразовые глаголы должны держать глагол и частицу вместе, за которыми следует дополнение.
explanation.uz: Ajralmaydigan frazeologik fe'llarda fe'l va zarra birga bo'lib, keyin to'ldiruvchi keladi.

options.answer: The meeting was put off until next week.
The meeting was put until next week off.
The meeting was off put until next week.

explanation.en: In passive voice, separable phrasal verbs stay together with the particle following the verb.
explanation.ru: В страдательном залоге разделяемые фразовые глаголы остаются вместе с частицей после глагола.
explanation.uz: Majhul nisbatda ajraladigan frazeologik fe'llar fe'l ketin zarra bilan birga qoladi.

options.answer: I need to figure this problem out.
I need to figure out this problem.
Both sentences are correct.

explanation.en: Separable phrasal verbs allow both positions when the object is a noun phrase.
explanation.ru: Разделяемые фразовые глаголы допускают обе позиции, когда дополнение является именной группой.
explanation.uz: Ajraladigan frazeologik fe'llar to'ldiruvchi ot birikma bo'lganda ikkala pozitsiyani ham qabul qiladi.

options.answer: The children grew quickly up.
The children grew up quickly.
The children up grew quickly.

explanation.en: Intransitive phrasal verbs cannot be separated and adverbs typically follow the complete phrasal verb.
explanation.ru: Непереходные фразовые глаголы нельзя разделять, и наречия обычно следуют за полным фразовым глаголом.
explanation.uz: O'tuvchi bo'lmagan frazeologik fe'llarni ajratib bo'lmaydi va ravishlar odatda to'liq frazeologik fe'l ketin keladi.

options.answer: She's looking forward to the party.
She's looking to the party forward.
She's forward looking to the party.

explanation.en: Three-word phrasal verbs are always inseparable and the object follows the complete phrasal verb.
explanation.ru: Трехсловные фразовые глаголы всегда неразделимы, и дополнение следует за полным фразовым глаголом.
explanation.uz: Uch so'zli frazeologik fe'llar doimo ajralmas va to'ldiruvchi to'liq frazeologik fe'l ketin keladi.

options.answer: He gave up smoking last year.
He gave smoking up last year.
He up gave smoking last year.

explanation.en: When the object is a long noun phrase or gerund, it's more natural to place it after the complete phrasal verb.
explanation.ru: Когда дополнение представляет собой длинную именную группу или герундий, естественнее поместить его после полного фразового глагола.
explanation.uz: To'ldiruvchi uzun ot birikma yoki gerundiy bo'lganda, uni to'liq frazeologik fe'l ketin qo'yish tabiiiyroq.

explanation.uz: Look up ma'lumot qidirish, odatda ma'lumotnoma yoki internetdan izlash degani.

explanation.uz: Put off biror narsani keyinroqqa qoldirish yoki kechiktirish degani.

explanation.uz: Take off yerdan ajralib uchishni boshlash degani (samolyotlar uchun).

explanation.uz: Turn down ovoz balandligi yoki intensivligini kamaytirish degani.

explanation.ru: Look forward to означает ожидать чего-то с удовольствием, всегда сопровождается 'to'.
explanation.uz: Look forward to biror narsani mamnuniyat bilan kutish, doimo 'to' bilan keladi.

explanation.uz: Give up biror narsani, ayniqsa odat yoki faoliyatni to'xtatish degani.

After getting dressed, she needed to pick ___2___ her dry cleaning before heading to the office. On her way, she ran ___3___ her old college friend Mike, whom she hadn't seen for months. They decided to catch ___4___ over coffee later that week. At the office, Sarah's boss told her that the client meeting had been put ___5___ until next Tuesday due to scheduling conflicts. This gave Sarah more time to work ___6___ the presentation details. During lunch, she called her mother to check ___7___ on her health after her recent surgery. Her mother was getting ___8___ well with the new nurse and feeling much better. In the afternoon, Sarah had to look ___9___ some important information in the company database for a colleague. She also needed to turn ___10___ her monthly report before 5 PM. After work, she stopped ___11___ at the grocery store to buy ingredients for dinner. explanation.en: This passage demonstrates various types of phrasal verbs: separable (wake up, pick up), inseparable (run into, look up), and three-word phrasal verbs (look forward to).
explanation.ru: Этот отрывок демонстрирует различные типы фразовых глаголов: разделяемые (wake up, pick up), неразделяемые (run into, look up) и трехсловные фразовые глаголы (look forward to).
explanation.uz: Bu matn turli xil frazeologik fe'llarni namoyish etadi: ajraladigan (wake up, pick up), ajralmaydigan (run into, look up) va uch so'zli frazeologik fe'llar (look forward to).
